summary: Sand Flat (Hwy 50, Eldorado NF): $36 single / $72 double confirmed; first-come with on-site Scan & Pay (recreation.gov listing is S&P only, not reservable); Memorial Day weekend-October; 29 public sites (6 walk-to); potable water added; pin at the river edge; phone and website added; note's 'Pacific RD' -> Placerville RD.
flags: BOOKING: recreation.gov facility 10361199 exists but its rules say 'scanAndPay' 'S&P Only' and no site carries permitted equipment - it is on-site payment, not reservations. Stored reservable false / fcfs always confirmed.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept; lead only): z19 imagery shows the pads 20-40 m from the South Fork American River (~30 m wide) through scattered pines and brush along the bank. The catalog has no per-site coordinates, so no site numbers can be named and no upgrade is proposed; a riverview call is possible if site photos show the river from named sites.

PIN: stored 38.76280,-120.32680 sits at the river edge ~230 m WSW of the FS point 38.763837,-120.32453 (under the 250 m threshold); the recreation.gov site points cluster at 38.76350,-120.32530, mid-campground - a re-pin there is suggested.
FIT: no rig length posted by FS or recreation.gov (no driveway lengths); imagery shows ordinary drive-in gravel spurs off a loop. Unknown, kept.
STATUS: the FS 'Site Closed' badge is the seasonal closure (Memorial weekend to October); nothing written to status.
